'''2001 San Diego Comic-Con Open Michael Girard Watch Your Phil - ComiCon winning Light deck''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Michael Girard]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 1st (10–0) at [[2001 San Diego Comic-Con Open]].<ref name="dt-17823">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17823 Watch Your Phil - ComiCon winning Light deck], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 26 July 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/17823/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/17823/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Watch Your Phil - ComiCon winning Light deck'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "Dvader" Girard
* '''Published:''' July 26, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' This is the Light deck that I used to help me go 10-0 through the San Diego ComiCon Open.

=== Strategy ===

Pretty typical WYS deck.  I chose more retreival then versatility or Podracing because I thought that it would give me the best chance in case I lost a podrace or I was playing against a Start Your Landing Deck with soo much direct damage.  Not much more to explain, you just have to feel the deck out, play it a few times in friendly games to get the feel for it and to know when you can do certain maneuvers.
